services.name: Guided Night Tour
services.desc: Join us for a fun night out on Ibis Bay! Single Kayak: $59.95 Double Kayak (Fits 2 People): $119.90 1 hour and 30 minutes About By using a brand new invention — super-bright waterproof LED lights that can be attached to a kayak or paddle board — Ibis Bay Paddlesports offers sunset tours that are unlike any other nature tour you can find in the Florida Keys. A lot of sea creatures are much more active at night, such as lobsters, crabs, rays and certain species of fish, so this activity lets you see the bay like never Most Popular!! · 1.5 Hour Tour

services.name: Key West Island Jetski Tour
services.desc: Welcome! 1.5 Hours About This is Guided 27 Mile, 90 minute tour around the island is an ultimate Key West experience. It offers fun, exhilaration and a unique perspective of the amazing waters around Key West as you jetski around the island from the Gulf of Mexico to the Atlantic Ocean and back again! What's Included Local Tour Guide 28-mile guided tour your own Jet Skis/Waverunners for the tour Multiple stops at places such as Southernmost point, Historic Key West Harbor, Florida Marine Sanctuary Local sandbar to jump off for a 1.5 Hour Tour • 400LBS Max per Jetski

quotes.text: Tour guide Brandon was AWESOME! He led us to all the animals! We seen baby sharks. Starfish. Sting ray. Tons of fish. Iguanas. He was fantastic! 5/5!
Awesome experience. Brandon was great. Saw sea life that is not visible in the day. So educational. Love every minute.
Had a blast with my moped rental. Made my vacation. Dan was a blast to talk to as well. 10/10 I'll be back.
